rationale: C02 plausibly supplied the child's letter template. Beyond the routine fact of transmitting legislation, the two letters share a closely matched opening that ties draft legislation to recommendations in a prior presidential message, followed by a policy justification, an enclosure from the responsible official describing the legislation in detail, notice of an identical letter to the other chamber, and a request for prompt favorable action. C01 and C17 contain similar elements, but their wording and overall sequence are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am transmitting for the consideration of the Congress a draft bill to carry out the recommendations on saline water research in my Natural Resources Message.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting for consideration by the Congress draft legislation to carry out the recommendation in my March ninth message on housing and community development
shared_material.explanation: The opening uses the same unusually complete drafting formula: transmission for congressional consideration, draft legislation, and implementation of recommendations in a specified earlier presidential message.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am enclosing a letter from the Secretary of the Interior describing this legislation in greater detail. A letter identical to this is being sent to the Speaker of the House of Representatives (President of the Senate).
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am enclosing a letter from the Director of the Bureau of the Budget describing the legislation in detail. A letter identical to this one is being sent to the Speaker of the House of Representatives (President of the Senate).
shared_material.explanation: This is a near-verbatim closing sequence, with only the enclosing official and minor wording changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am confident that the Congress will share my view that we must move ahead with this important program, and I urge that favorable and prompt consideration be given this legislation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that prompt action can be scheduled on this important legislation and that the Congress will act favorably on the proposal.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the substantive case with closely parallel appeals for prompt and favorable congressional action on important legislation.
